title: Price rows per ticker
statementMd:
Count the number of price rows per symbol.

Expected columns: `symbol`, `days`.

Tables: `tickers`, `prices`.

Row order does not matter.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT symbol, COUNT(*) AS days FROM prices GROUP BY symbol;
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
